articles.title: Russia charges Telegram founder Pavel Durov with aiding terrorism
articles.snippet: The charges could result in life imprisonment, escalating an investigation that has already led to over 100 million rubles in fines for the platform this year.

articles.title: The 100x obsession: Fundamentals grow in importance as crypto matures
articles.snippet: Crypto’s fundamentals have never been stronger, yet degens keep chasing hot new narratives. Behavioral finance may explain why get rich quick stories continue to beat substance.

articles.title: Zcash says Ironwood proof rules out undetectable counterfeiting bugs
articles.snippet: Zcash researchers published more than 2,700 machine-checked theorems designed to rule out undetectable counterfeiting bugs in Ironwood.

articles.title: Core Scientific revenue doubles in Q2 as AI colocation expansion accelerates
articles.snippet: Core Scientific reported strong second-quarter revenue growth as AI colocation became its largest business, though a non-cash accounting charge resulted in a $1.15 billion net loss.

articles.title: Teacher Arrested for Clapping at AI Data Center Public Hearing
articles.snippet: The arrest of a Kansas teacher at a public hearing highlights growing resistance to AI data centers across the United States.
